description: This plot illustrates the number of shared experts for two samples as a function of sample token count across six different categories. The x-axis is labeled "Sample Token Count" and uses a logarithmic scale (base 2), with values ranging from $2^9$ to $2^{20}$ and tick marks at every power of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Shared Experts for Two Samples" and uses a linear scale, with tick marks ranging from 2.0 to 6.0 at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains six solid lines without markers. The "Intent" line, colored reddish-brown, begins at approximately 3.8 at $2^9$, dips to 3.9 at $2^{11}$, rises to 5.5 at $2^{13}$, and eventually reaches 6.0 at $2^{19}$, remaining there at $2^{20}$. The "Summary" line, colored blue, starts at roughly 1.9 at $2^9$, increases sharply to 4.7 at $2^{11}$, dips slightly to 4.5 at $2^{12}$, and then steadily climbs to end at approximately 5.9 at $2^{20}$. The "Law" line, colored tan, starts at 3.6 at $2^9$, peaks at 5.1 at $2^{11}$, drops to 4.6 at $2^{12}$, reaches another peak of 5.8 at $2^{14}$, drops again to 5.5 at $2^{15}$, and finishes near 6.0 at $2^{20}$. The "Translation" line, colored purple, begins at 5.1 at $2^9$, rises to 5.3 at $2^{10}$, drops to 4.7 at $2^{11}$, and then generally increases to finish at approximately 5.9 at $2^{20}$. The "Code" line, colored grey, starts at roughly 1.9 at $2^9$, remains relatively flat until $2^{10}$, rises to 3.7 at $2^{13}$, declines to 3.1 at $2^{14}$, and then exhibits a steep upward trend, ending at approximately 5.8 at $2^{20}$. Finally, the "Math" line, colored olive green, starts at 3.8 at $2^9$, rises steadily to 5.3 at $2^{13}$, and continues a gradual upward trend to end at approximately 5.9 at $2^{20}$, with a minor dip to 5.8 at $2^{19}$.
